name: paragrafiq
description: Read-only access to Czech law: statutes as worded on a given date, court decisions, authority guidance and explanatory reports, each with a link to its source where one exists. Includes a research skill for Czech legal questions.

interface.longDescription: Paragrafiq gives your assistant read-only access to Czech law. It can find a Czech or EU act, read a provision as worded on a specific date, show when a provision changed and what the transitional provisions of an amendment say, find the statutory definition of a term, and point to cross-cutting general rules (such as those on time limits, limitation or which law applies over time) that a provision does not itself refer to. It searches and reads decisions of the Czech Supreme Court, Supreme Administrative Court and Constitutional Court, shows how later decisions cited or treated a decision as far as such links are recorded (they are incomplete), and searches public-authority guidance and explanatory reports to bills. Results link to their source on paragrafiq.cz where a page exists. A bundled skill gives your assistant a research method for Czech legal questions: which tools to use in what order, how to check the date and the wording that apply, and when to say that a source does not answer the question. Paragrafiq does not generate answers during your conversation: your assistant composes the answer from the material Paragrafiq returns. Some case summaries and headnotes were generated by AI in advance and are marked as such in the results. Sign in with your Paragrafiq account. Legal texts and decisions are in Czech. Information tool, not legal advice.
capabilities: Read provisions as worded on a date
See when a provision changed and its transitional provisions
Search and read court decisions and later decisions citing them
Research method (skill) for Czech legal questions
defaultPrompt: What does Section 2254 of the Czech Civil Code say as worded on 1 January 2020?
Find Czech Supreme Court decisions on returning a rental deposit after a lease ends.
Has Section 1124 of the Czech Civil Code changed since 2012? What do the transitional provisions say?

positive.description: Provision wording at a past date
positive.prompt: What does Section 2254 of the Czech Civil Code say as worded on 1 January 2015?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the wording of Section 2254 of Act No. 89/2012 Coll. that was in force on 1 January 2015 (the wording valid from 1 January 2014), with the dates of that wording and a paragrafiq.cz link to the provision.

positive.prompt: Find Czech Supreme Court decisions on returning a rental deposit after a lease ends.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of matching decisions, each with docket number, court, date and a paragrafiq.cz URL, and marks the results as search candidates rather than settled case law.

positive.description: Find one decision by docket number
positive.prompt: Show me Constitutional Court decision I. ÚS 1441/11.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the decision of the Constitutional Court of 22 September 2011 (ECLI:CZ:US:2011:1.US.1441.11.1) and returns its headnote with a link to the decision on paragrafiq.cz; how later decisions treated it is available on request.

positive.description: History of a provision and transitional provisions
positive.prompt: Has Section 1124 of the Czech Civil Code changed since 2012? What do the transitional provisions of the 2020 amendment say?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the dates on which the text of Section 1124 of Act No. 89/2012 Coll. changed, with the wording after each change and the amending act, and returns the transitional provisions of Act No. 163/2020 Coll. (effective 1 July 2020), marking whether any of them mentions Section 1124, without deciding which wording governs a particular case.
Identifies Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (CELEX 32016R0679), states that it is in force and gives its title.

negative.description: Drafting a legal document is not supported
negative.prompt: Write me a lawsuit against my neighbour.

negative.description: Listing the whole database is not supported
A provision that does not exist
negative.prompt: What does Section 99999 of the Czech Civil Code say?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.6: a new set of 19 read-only tools for Czech law (adds the history of a provision and the transitional provisions of an amendment, general rules, statutory definitions and how later decisions treated a decision) and a bundled research skill. Results link to their source on paragrafiq.cz where a page exists.

cs-CZ.subtitle: České právo se zdroji
cs-CZ.description: Paragrafiq dává vašemu asistentovi přístup jen ke čtení českého práva. Najde český nebo unijní předpis, přečte ustanovení ve znění k určitému datu, ukáže, kdy se ustanovení změnilo a co říkají přechodná ustanovení novely, najde zákonnou definici pojmu a upozorní na průřezová obecná pravidla (například o lhůtách, promlčení nebo o tom, které právo se použije v čase), na která ustanovení samo neodkazuje. Vyhledá a přečte rozhodnutí Nejvyššího soudu, Nejvyššího správního soudu a Ústavního soudu, ukáže, jak pozdější rozhodnutí dané rozhodnutí citovala nebo s ním naložila, pokud jsou tyto vazby zaznamenány (nejsou úplné), a prohledá pokyny úřadů a důvodové zprávy k zákonům. Výsledky odkazují na zdroj na paragrafiq.cz, kde stránka existuje. Součástí je skill: postup pro asistenta při českých právních otázkách, tedy které nástroje použít v jakém pořadí, jak ověřit rozhodné datum a znění a kdy říct, že zdroj otázku nezodpovídá. Paragrafiq během rozhovoru negeneruje odpovědi: odpověď skládá váš asistent z podkladů, které Paragrafiq vrátí. Část shrnutí a právních vět vznikla předem pomocí AI a je tak ve výsledcích označena. Přihlaste se účtem Paragrafiq. Texty předpisů a rozhodnutí jsou v češtině. Informační nástroj, ne právní poradenství.
